kosit-testsuite/src/test/business-cases/: XRechnung extension scenario with third-party payment (BG-DEX-09, cac:PrepaidPayment, two prepaid amounts). The model has no BG-DEX-09, so on re-reading the amount due is computed without them; the conversion reports this in parse().totalsCheck instead of hiding it. Extension-only terms are out of scope.
cen-examples/cii/examples/XRechnung-O.xm: The document has an empty buyer electronic address element that carries only schemeID="EM". There is no address to preserve, so the writer emits nothing and the scheme is gone on the second read. No business value is lost.
cen-examples/cii/examples/huf_example_ci: Hungarian invoice in HUF that states VAT rounded to the nearest 100 forint (1,867,900 where 27% of the taxable amount is 1,867,860). The CEN rules accept it; Conformo recomputes totals from the lines to the minor unit and reports the difference (parse().totalsCheck, and a warning on convert). Hungarian national rounding is not implemented.
